base_member_text: [L569-L645] (HIGH/MPI correctness limitation) fill_tide_grid updates each local interior from its local cross-shore maximum and local boundary endpoints with no MPI reduction or global-coordinate reconstruction, and the source itself states this only works for cross-shore-strip decompositions.
audit_member_text: [L569-L572,L584-L634] (MED/MPI correctness) The source explicitly states that `fill_tide_grid` is not fully MPI-compliant for distributed grids, while this routine supplies interior tide levels and gradients for instant and hybrid tide modes.

base_member_text: [L249-L257, L379-L401] (MED/unguarded geometric division) Tidal gradients divide by boundary distance differences (or s%dnz for 1-D) without validating nonzero spacing, so a degenerate or repeated boundary coordinate produces invalid gradients.

[L489-L499, L507-L524, L534-L548, L616-L638] (MED/unguarded interpolation denominator) Spatial interpolation uses reciprocal endpoint or ridge-to-end distances without guarding coincident endpoints or a maximum located exactly at the relevant endpoint.
audit_member_text: [L251-L254,L379-L401,L489-L545,L616-L634] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Multiple tide gradients and spatial interpolants divide by grid spacing or endpoint-distance differences without guarding coincident points or zero spacing, allowing infinities or NaNs on degenerate grids or boundary placements.

base_member_text: [L543-L553] (HIGH/incorrect gradient selection) In case 4 on a lateral boundary, points beyond the separating maximum receive tide2 but are assigned tidegradient1 rather than tidegradient2.
audit_member_text: [L534-L552] (MED/gradient consistency) In case 4, points beyond `distmaxzbl` receive the tide-2 water level but `tidegradient1`, making the reported gradient inconsistent with the selected side's forcing.

base_member_text: [L420-L428] (MED/inconsistent search extent) The local maximum bed elevation is computed only over imin:imax,jmin:jmax, but maxloc searches the entire row or column, so halo or non-boundary values can supply a distance unrelated to maxzbl in decomposed domains.

audit_member_text: [L157-L191] (MED/state/dispatch) The `tideloc` and nested `paulrevere` selections have no default branches, so an unsupported value can leave the four module-level tide corner values unchanged from an earlier timestep.

[L558-L564] (MED/state consistency) Water levels are clipped upward to the bed after gradients have been assigned, but the corresponding tide gradients are not recomputed or neutralized where clipping changes the surface.

[L230,L256,L286] (LOW/dimension contract) Boundary logic tests `par%ny` but indexes extents using `s%ny`, creating an unclear and potentially unsafe contract if parameter and allocated-grid dimensions ever differ.
